title: OPAL-RT Configuration
description: Configure the RT-LAB project to trace and how its signals and parameters are read

project_file.title: Project File
project_file.description: The RT-LAB project (.llp) on this machine. Leave empty to use the one project RT-LAB has open with a model, or press Auto-configure.
project_file.ui:placeholder: the one active project when empty

poll_interval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
poll_interval.description: How often every traced signal is read while the model is loaded. Each read is stamped with the host time it was made.

parameter_interval.title: Parameter Interval (seconds)
parameter_interval.description: How long one pass over every traced block parameter takes, read in chunks spread across it. 0 traces no parameters (they stay readable and writable).

include.title: Include
include.description: Path globs to trace (`*` within one segment, `**` any depth), e.g. rtdemo1/sm_computation/** or **/Gain*/*. Empty traces every signal and parameter.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Path globs not traced, e.g. **/OpComm/**. Wins over include.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Trace source the model publishes under, so events read '<prefix>/<model>/<subsystem>/<block>'.

rtlab_path.title: RT-LAB Install Path
rtlab_path.description: RT-LAB version directory to load RtlabApi from (e.g. C:/OPAL-RT/RT-LAB/v2025.4.7.43). Empty uses the newest under C:/OPAL-RT/RT-LAB.

timeout.title: Action Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long an action waits for RT-LAB. A write still queued behind another request when it expires is cancelled, never sent late.

parameter_chunk.title: Parameter Chunk
parameter_chunk.description: Parameters per read. Smaller chunks keep the signal poll on time; larger ones finish the pass with fewer requests.

demo.title: Demo
demo.description: Run the built-in demo model (a PI-controlled plant with a setpoint, gains and a variable) instead of an RT-LAB project. No RT-LAB needed.
